data.exact_reserve_text: In 2018, there has been an overall deficit of GBP 9.0m on prior year reserves (2017:deficit GBP 1.8m).

prior_year_events.event_name: Hurricanes Harvey and Irma (and Hurricane Maria aggregate: HIM)
prior_year_events.impact_description: Material losses from Hurricanes Harvey and Irma and more modest losses from Hurricane Maria; the Syndicate's aggregate estimated net exposure to these events (HIM) was GBP 8m at year end 2017, reducing to GBP 6.5m at year end 2018.

named_events.loss_description: Aggregate estimated net exposure was GBP 8m at year end 2017, reduced to GBP 6.5m at year end 2018; Harvey and Irma were material, Maria more modest.

named_events.event_name: 2018 calendar year events (Hawaii volcano, Hurricanes Florence and Michael, California wildfires)
named_events.loss_description: Estimated net exposure to the 2018 calendar year events is GBP 17m, split GBP 4m/GBP 13m to the 2017 and 2018 years of account respectively.

data.standardized_narrative: Gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2018 were GBP 88.097m. Using the reported gross claims development table, underwriting years 2014-2016 show a net adverse prior-year development of approximately GBP 5.443m (about 6.2% of opening gross reserves), i.e. a strengthening of reserves. The report also states an overall prior year reserve deficit of GBP 9.0m (2017: deficit GBP 1.8m). The syndicate experienced named catastrophe losses (notably Hurricanes Harvey/Irma/Maria and various 2018 events) which impacted years of account and reinsurance recoveries, and management has taken actions including profitable commutation of a material US casualty contract.
raw_causal_phrases: adverse loss experience in the Property Insurance business.

we have commuted a material US Casualty contract at a profit, removing a significant amount of reserve risk from this year.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (5.443m) calculated from the gross claims development triangle (columns 2014-2016) and excludes the two most recent underwriting years (2017,2018) as required. The report also states an overall prior-year deficit of GBP 9.0m but does not explicitly state whether that is gross or net; the triangle-derived figure is gross and used as the primary PYD source (confidence 0.8). Named-event numbers quoted in the narrative (e.g. net exposures of GBP 8.0m / GBP 6.5m for HIM and GBP 17.0m for 2018 events) are net figures and have been recorded under named events; they were not used to compute gross PYD. Line-of-business reserve movements are not explicitly quantified in the report except for narrative indications (property adverse, casualty commutation), so LOB movement amounts are null where not stated.
